title: Micro-Macro Tensor Neural Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Collisional Plasma
abstract: arXiv:2512.24205v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Plasma kinetic equations exhibit pronounced sensitivity to microscopic perturbations in model parameters and data, making reliable and efficient uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for predictive simulations. However, the cost of uncertainty sampling, the high-dimensional phase space, and multiscale stiffness pose severe challenges to both computational efficiency and error control in traditional numerical methods. These aspects are further emphasized in presence of collisions where the high-dimensional nonlocal collision integrations and conservation properties pose severe constraints. To overcome this, we present a variance-reduced Monte Carlo framework for UQ in the Vlasov--Poisson--Landau (VPL) system, in which neural network surrogates replace the multiple costly evaluations of the Landau collision term. translated_title: 面向碰撞等离子体不确定性量化的微观-宏观张量神经代理模型
translated_abstract: 等离子体动理学方程对模型参数和数据中的微观扰动表现出显著敏感性，因此可靠且高效的不确定性量化（UQ）对于预测性模拟至关重要。然而，不确定性采样的成本、高维相空间以及多尺度刚性问题，对传统数值方法的计算效率和误差控制都构成了严峻挑战。在存在碰撞的情况下，这些问题进一步加剧，因为高维非局域碰撞积分与守恒性质带来了严格的约束。为克服这些困难，我们提出了一个针对 Vlasov--Poisson--Landau（VPL）系统不确定性量化的方差缩减蒙特卡洛框架，其中神经网络代理模型替代了对 Landau 碰撞项的多次昂贵求值。该方法将一个高保真、渐近保持的 VPL 求解器与低成本的强相关代理模型相耦合……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于 Vlasov–Poisson–Landau 系统不确定性量化的方差缩减蒙特卡洛框架，利用神经网络代理模型替代昂贵的 Landau 碰撞项重复求值，将高保真渐近保持求解器与低成本强相关代理相结合，从而在保证精度与守恒性质的同时大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: A variance-reduced Monte Carlo framework for uncertainty quantification in the Vlasov–Poisson–Landau system that replaces costly repeated evaluations of the Landau collision term with neural network surrogates, coupling a high-fidelity asymptotic-preserving solver with inexpensive, strongly correlated surrogates to achieve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy or conservation.
